selection_rule: First two complete mornings are development dates; next three complete mornings are final dates. Additional complete mornings are reserved. Dates, cutoff, fixed OD pairs and source-based targets are selected before morning policy results. Targets follow the existing development rule and null findings remain included.
replay_label: Recorded frames sampled every 15 minutes; no interpolation. Unrecorded intervals remain gaps.
publication: Private preparation only until the existing release gates, including source publication permission, pass.
